name: 4-fluoroselegiline
summary: 4-Fluoroselegiline, or p-fluoro-L-deprenyl, is a substituted amphetamine designer drug. It is the enantiopure L- enantiomer of 4-fluorodeprenyl and the 4-fluorinated derivative of selegiline (L-deprenyl).

pharmacology.text: 4-Fluoroselegiline is a selective and irreversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase B and monoaminergic activity enhancer. A radiolabelled derivative incorporating 18F is used to study MAO-B inhibition in both in vivo and in vitro experiments.
